description: Tool to retrieve a report task's content. Use this after creating a report task with CreateReportTask and confirming it is in ACTIVE state. This method returns an error if the report task's state is not ACTIVE.

inputSchema.description: Request model for querying a report task's content.

limit.description: Optional. Number of rows to return (max 250,000). If unspecified, 10,000 rows are returned. Must be positive. Limited by the ReportTask's own limit.
limit.title: Limit

name.description: Required. Report task name in format 'properties/{propertyId}/reportTasks/{reportTaskId}'. The report task must be in ACTIVE state.
name.title: Name

offset.description: Optional. Row offset for pagination (0-indexed). First request omits offset or sets to 0. For subsequent pages, set to the previous limit value.
offset.title: Offset

inputSchema.title: QueryReportTaskRequest

name: query_report_task

DimensionHeader.description: Header for a dimension column in the report.
DimensionHeader.title: DimensionHeader

DimensionValue.description: Dimension value for a row in the report.
DimensionValue.title: DimensionValue

MetricHeader.description: Header for a metric column in the report.

type.description: Data type of the metric (e.g., TYPE_INTEGER, TYPE_FLOAT).
type.title: Type

MetricHeader.title: MetricHeader

MetricValue.description: Metric value for a row in the report.
MetricValue.title: MetricValue

QueryReportTaskResponse.description: Response model containing the report task's data.

dimensionHeaders.description: Dimension column headers matching the order of dimension values in rows.
dimensionHeaders.title: Dimension Headers

maximums.description: Maximum values of metrics, if requested.
maximums.title: Maximums

metadata.description: Response metadata with additional information about the report.
metadata.title: Metadata

metricHeaders.description: Metric column headers matching the order of metric values in rows.
metricHeaders.title: Metric Headers

minimums.description: Minimum values of metrics, if requested.
minimums.title: Minimums

rowCount.description: Total number of rows in the query result.
rowCount.title: Row Count

rows.description: Rows of dimension and metric values in the report.
rows.title: Rows

totals.description: Totaled values of metrics, if requested in the report definition.
totals.title: Totals

QueryReportTaskResponse.title: QueryReportTaskResponse

currencyCode.description: Currency code used in the report (ISO 4217 format).
currencyCode.title: Currency Code

dataLossFromOtherRow.description: Whether data loss from the 'other' row occurred.
dataLossFromOtherRow.title: Data Loss From Other Row

emptyReason.description: Reason why the report is empty, if applicable.
emptyReason.title: Empty Reason

samplingMetadatas.description: Sampling metadata if the report is sampled.
samplingMetadatas.title: Sampling Metadatas

subjectToThresholding.description: Whether the report is subject to data thresholding.
subjectToThresholding.title: Subject To Thresholding

timeZone.description: Timezone used in the report (IANA Time Zone database format).
timeZone.title: Time Zone
